definitions.BLOCKING: Prevents a planned calculation, label or model from being trusted until resolved.
definitions.NON_BLOCKING_WITH_RESTRICTIONS: Work can proceed; named metrics, features or labels carry a documented, scoped restriction.
definitions.INFORMATIONAL: Context only; no metric needs a restriction beyond a note.
